# FDG3083

> DO use left and right for binary operator overload parameter names if there is no meaning to the parameters.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.7.1 Naming Operator Overload Parameters.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
public static TimeSpan operator-(DateTimeOffset left,
                                 DateTimeOffset right)
public static bool operator==(DateTimeOffset left,
                              DateTimeOffset right)
```
